name: PM-KISAN
summary: Income support for eligible land-holding farmer families.
benefit: ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments
eligibility_note: Eligibility is decided under the official scheme rules; exclusions and state verification apply.

name: Rythu Bharosa
summary: Telangana agricultural investment support for eligible farmers.
benefit: Current Telangana government pages describe ₹12,000 per acre per year, subject to the scheme rules.
eligibility_note: State-level eligibility and farmer/land verification apply.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
summary: Crop insurance support for notified crops/areas under the scheme and applicable policy terms.
benefit: Insurance protection against covered crop losses; claim amount depends on notified crop, area, policy and loss assessment.
eligibility_note: Availability depends on notified crop/area/season and applicable enrollment rules.
